registry_info.name: wavefunctions_extra
registry_info.description: Additional wavefunction artifacts not in the main wavefunctions.json — sine spaces, sound timelines, modulor constructions, and cochlear models.
registry_info.theoretical_grounding: Wave mechanics, Fourier analysis, Le Corbusier's Modulor proportional system, cochlear mechanics, sound synthesis

coshlea.name: Cochlea Model
coshlea.description: Model of the cochlea — the spiral organ in the inner ear that performs a biological Fourier transform. Frequency-to-position mapping: high frequencies at the base, low at the apex.

modulor_man.name: Modulor Man
modulor_man.description: Le Corbusier's Modulor proportional system in 3D — the human body as generator of harmonic measurements. Architecture derived from the golden ratio applied to human scale.

modulor_man_interactive.name: Modulor Man (Interactive)
modulor_man_interactive.description: Interactive Modulor proportional system — adjust body proportions and see how architectural measurements change. The relationship between human form and designed space.

sine_space.name: Sine Space
sine_space.description: 3D space defined by sine waves — walls, floors, and ceilings undulate according to wave parameters. An environment where the sine function becomes architecture.

sine_wall.name: Sine Wall
sine_wall.description: A wall of oscillating elements driven by sine functions — amplitude, frequency, and phase visible as physical displacement. Wave parameters you can see and feel.

sine_oscillation.name: Sine Oscillation
sine_oscillation.description: Pure sine wave oscillation visualization in 2D — the most fundamental periodic motion. Amplitude, frequency, phase, and their relationship to circular motion.

sound_timeline.name: Sound Timeline
sound_timeline.description: Audio timeline controller — visualize and manipulate sound as a waveform in time. Scrub through audio, see frequency content evolve, understand sound as time-domain signal.

vertical_wave_lines.name: Vertical Wave Lines
vertical_wave_lines.description: Array of vertical lines displaced by wave functions — interference, standing waves, and superposition made visible as a wall of oscillating rods.

doppler_effect_demo.name: Doppler Effect Demo
doppler_effect_demo.description: Moving source emits concentric wave rings — compression ahead (blue shift) and stretching behind (red shift). Rings expand from emission positions, naturally demonstrating how relative motion changes observed frequency.
